label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter name directly flows through getParameterNames(), gets stored in param, passed to doSomething which returns it unchanged, then written to response via getWriter().println() without any sanitization or filtering. The guard logic only filters out specific parameter names but still allows others to pass through unfiltered to the XSS sink.

evidence.note: parameter flows from request.getParameterNames() through doSomething() to response.getWriter().println()
